meta.scope: A separately identified candidate and decision-relevant review and company-page checks; this does not replace the original 16-record scored dataset.
meta.method: License and complaint pages were fetched directly from CSLB. Company pages were read directly. The HomeAdvisor profile was fetched directly; Yelp search-result text was obtained via web search because direct Yelp access returned HTTP 403. Reviews and vendor claims are not independent proof of performance, job acceptance, price or availability.
